title: Laplacian Algebras and Subcalibrations for Minimal Hypercones
summary: We develop an algebraic mechanism based on Laplacian algebras for constructing minimal hypercones and determining their variational properties. Generator counts and degrees organize the constructions; homogeneous multipliers depending on the generators yield subcalibration fields, stability bounds and quantitative area-minimizing inequalities. Two-generator isoparametric algebras give polynomial subcalibrations for their minimizing hypercones.
